1) Stable Floor (Conservative)
  - Min GPUs: 8 (NVIDIA L4 equivalent) reserved
  - Cluster size: 8 GPUs in a single pool, warm-standby nodes for pre-warm
  - Ramp: flat for months 0–3, review at month 3 for increase
  - Good for steady low-volume inference and strict cost predictability

2) Growth Mode (Recommended)
  - Min GPUs: 12 reserved with burst to 20 via prioritized burst lanes
  - Cluster size: 12 primary + 8 burstable GPUs. Autoscaling policy: scale to target latency P95 <= 220ms
  - Ramp: 2 additional GPUs at week 6, +4 at week 12 based on usage signals
  - Adds buffer for feature-driven demand, balances cost and headroom

3) Acceleration (Aggressive)
  - Min GPUs: 24 reserved; support for dedicated multi-model lanes
  - Cluster size: 24+ (split across two AZs for resilience)
  - Ramp: fast ramp aligned with launch, pre-provisioning recommended to minimize cold starts
  - Best for high-throughput and low-latency SLAs at scale

Next steps: if you can confirm which of the three lanes feels closest to your appetite we’ll produce a deal-specific worksheet and a proposed ramp annex to include in the SOW.

Call windows: I have availability Thu 11/19 10:00–12:00 PST or Fri 11/20 14:00–16:00 PST.

—Jonas

Numeric ramp options (compact view):
- Variant A — Conservative (Low cashflow)
  • Guaranteed Floor: 8 GPUs
  • Ramp: 8 GPUs (day 0–60), review at day 60 for +4

- Variant B — Growth (Modified per procurement) — RECOMMENDED
  • Guaranteed Floor: 10 GPUs (day 0–60) -> 12 GPUs (week 6) -> 16 GPUs (week 12 conditional on usage)
  • Cluster architecture: 12 primary + 4 burst lanes (total burstable to 20)
  • Autoscaling: target token batching + KV cache retention tuned for low-latency models
  • SLA note: P95 latency target 220ms when operating on Guaranteed Floor
- Variant C — Acceleration
  • Guaranteed Floor: 24 GPUs; staged AZ split; aggressive pre-warm and multi-model lanes
  • Ramp: 24 day 0, +8 day 30 if throughput triggers met

Operational notes for procurement to include in SOW:
- Activation window: Redwood will provision the Guaranteed Floor within 10 business days of the effective date for Variant B; expedited provisioning (3–5 business days) available as an add-on.
- Burst mechanics: bursts above Guaranteed Floor use prioritized lanes and are billed at a defined burst rate. Redwood provides a monthly report with token-level cost and latency breakdowns.
- Early termination: standard proration applies; see Schedule C for decommit and run-off terms.
